# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 3 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 5 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Border — 2 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ground, #e6e2d9);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ground, #161719);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e6e2d9;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ground` | #e6e2d9 | #161719 | Page background. Everything sits on ground first. |
| `--surface` | #f2efe8 | #1f2023 | Panels, code blocks, inputs and tiles placed on ground. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #1c1d1f);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #ece8df);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #1c1d1f;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #1c1d1f | #ece8df | Text and solid marks on ground and surface (13:1 or more in both themes). Solid fills for realized, native things. |
| `--ink-muted` | #55534e | #a8a49a | Secondary text, labels and control borders on ground and surface (5.9:1 or more in both themes). |

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-checked` | #f2efe8 | #161719 | Text and marks on a checked fill (6.3:1 light, 7.7:1 dark). |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--rule, #a9a49a);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--rule, #3a3b3f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #a9a49a;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--rule` | #a9a49a | #3a3b3f | Decorative hairlines between sections only. Below 3:1, so never the only edge of a control. |
| `--checked` | #275f53 | #6fb8a4 | Proven, passing, closed. Also the focus ring. Text on ground and surface (5.7:1 light, 7.7:1 dark). Always paired with a word or check mark. |
| `--trap` | #a63a24 | #e0795f | Runtime traps and rejections only, used small. Text on ground and surface (5.0:1 light, 6.0:1 dark). Always paired with a word or cross mark. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 300 56px/62px "Omega Serif", "Noto Serif Display", Georgia, serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display);
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 56px / 62px | 300 | `display` | Page titles, one per page, in Omega Serif Light. Greek letters at any size. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 32px / 40px | 500 | `display` | Section headings, in Omega Serif Medium. |
| `reading` | `.reading`, `--text-reading` | 18px / 29px | 400 | `display` | Long-form text in Omega Serif Regular: guides, specs, essays. At most 68 characters a line. |
| `subheading` | `.subheading`, `--text-subheading` | 20px / 28px | 600 | `display` | Subsections, card titles. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 26px | 400 | `sans` | Running text, at most 68 characters a line. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 13px / 18px, letter-spacing 0.02em | 500 | `mono` | Metadata, place names, paths, counts. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 14px / 22px | 400 | `mono` | Code and commands, on surface. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Omega Serif", "Noto Serif Display", Georgia, serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"IBM Plex Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace` |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/OmegaSerif-Light.woff2`, `fonts/OmegaSerif-Regular.woff2` and `fonts/OmegaSerif-Medium.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/OmegaSerif-Light.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/OmegaSerif-Light.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Omega Serif | `fonts/OmegaSerif-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-display)` | `omega-serif` |

Every face: `fonts/OmegaSerif-Light.woff2` (Omega Serif, 300), `fonts/OmegaSerif-Regular.woff2` (Omega Serif, 400), `fonts/OmegaSerif-Medium.woff2` (Omega Serif, 500).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Between an icon and its label. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Inside controls; between lines of a label group. |
| `--space-3` | 16px | Tile padding; between related items. |
| `--space-4` | 32px | Between groups; page gutter on wide screens. |
| `--space-5` | 64px | Between page sections. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-stone: 0) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-stone), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-stone` | 0 | The default corner for every block, tile and panel. |
| `--radius-chamfer` | 2px | Buttons and inputs only, so controls read as touchable. |
| `--radius-arch` | 9999px | Top corners only, to make an arch: status pips, section markers, arch-topped tiles. Never all four corners. |
